summary.text: Bernard Flowers is the Republican nominee for Maryland's 3rd Congressional District and a retired U.S. Air Force lieutenant colonel with nearly 21 years of active-duty service. He later worked in banking and as a Department of Defense civil servant, and ran in the 2022 Republican primary for the 2nd District before winning the 2026 nomination here.

paragraphs.text: Flowers was born in Lumberton, North Carolina.

He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Pembroke in 1987 and a graduate degree from Golden Gate University in 1991, and he graduated from the U.S. Air Force War College in 2006.

He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1987 to 2008; according to his Ballotpedia survey response, his service included an assignment at the Pentagon on September 11, 2001, and deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan.

After retiring from the military, Flowers worked in banking and then returned to the Department of Defense as a civil servant, where he says he helped stand up U.S. Cyber Command and served as NORAD and U.S. Northern Command's Senior Technical Advisor at Fort Meade.
Ballotpedia lists his associations as Disabled American Veterans, the Ft. Meade Rifle and Pistol Club, and Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity.
Flowers ran in the 2022 Republican primary for Maryland's 2nd Congressional District, finishing fourth with 13.2% of the vote.
He won the June 23, 2026 Republican primary for the 3rd District with 48.9% of the vote over John White, Ray Bly, and Felix Seier, and he faces Rep. Sarah Elfreth in the general election.
